observer: Codex-assisted operator using native Muse chat UI
method: Periodic native-chat accessibility observations covered both due times and continued beyond the full 120-second grace window. Final full-state observation found no notification delivering the cancelled reminder. Earlier setup/change/cancel acknowledgments quoting the text were not counted as notifications. The separate screen-break reminder and late research update were distinguishable by their run markers. Raw UI logs are retained privately because they include unrelated history and private identifiers.
limitations: Operator-attested periodic channel observation, not an independently exported message-transport log. Scheduler creation/update/removal evidence is separately supplied by Muse.
